title: Guide article page
description: One content/*.json file for layout=article. Matches the fields build.py reads for item and mechanic pages. Unknown keys are allowed so a draft note can ride along; build.py only reads the keys below.

path.description: Public path with trailing slashes. Depth 1: /town-picker/. Depth 2: /builds/summon/. The filename may differ.

title.description: Document <title>. Query phrase plus a differentiator.

description.description: Meta description. The answer to this URL's single intent.

h1.description: The only visible H1. Do not repeat an h1 inside body.

meta.description: Status line printed under the H1.

body.description:
HTML fragment. Opens with a

lead. Closes with a Related h2 or a paragraph that starts with 'Related:' so the before-related ad slot has a marker. Internal links are relative to path depth.

prefixItems.description: Site path, or empty string on the current crumb.

in_guides.description: true lists the page on the guides hub.

home_also.description: Present only when the page should appear in the homepage More-to-explore list.

order.description: Sort key shared with the guides hub and sitemap priority bands. Homepage uses 0.

sitemap_exclude.description: true omits the URL from sitemap.xml. Leave unset on indexable long-tail pages.
